title: Auction Settlement Covenant Contract
description: Validates highest-bidder payload, enforces reserve met, locks seller/buyer outputs, authorizes settlement.

auctioneer.responsibility: Configure auction parameters, start/end, reserve price

highestBidder.responsibility: Provide winning bid tx, sign settlement covenant spend

seller.responsibility: Approve winning bid, authorize payout release

witness.responsibility: Validate reserve met, confirm bid ordering

stateTransitions.action: Release seller payout, award item to buyer

guards: refund amounts match original bid UTXOs

covenantInputs.name: highest-bid-utxo
covenantInputs.purpose: Locked bid output from auctioneer funding

covenantOutputs.name: change-to-auctioneer
covenantOutputs.condition: if bid-amount < reserve, refund to bidder instead

checks.name: role-separated-outputs
checks.check: seller-output spends to seller-role-key, buyer-output to buyer-role-key

checks.name: input-outpoint-match
checks.check: settlement-tx input.prevTxid matches highest-bid UTXO txid

happy-path: 2. Build settlement-spend tx with seller/buyer payouts
sad-path: 1. Try settlement with bid < reserve → should fail script validation
2. Try settlement with wrong bidder signature → should fail sig check
3. Try settlement with mismatched auction ID → should fail payload check

boundaries: Auction-setup (open/close) happens off-covenant via timestamps/DAA scores; settlement covenant only handles the close-to-payout transition.
Highest-bid tracking (ordering) is app-layer responsibility; covenant trusts the payload commitment.
Multi-bid management (refunds of losing bids) happens separately; settlement covenant focuses on winner payout.
Seller can cancel before settlement (custody control); after settlement-tx accepted, refund requires 2-of-3 approval.
nextSteps: 1. Define auctionContract.mjs with settlement payload validation
2. Write Silverscript covenant that enforces role-separated outputs
3. Generate settlement-drafts (unsigned) that spend highest-bid UTXO
4. Test happy/sad paths with local TN12 wasm
5. Integrate with OpenClaw KasWare signing (seller approval step)
